    <p class="eyebrow">BACKGROUND / CURRICULUM VITAE</p>
    <h1>A life spent asking <em>better questions.</em></h1>
    <p>I’m a quantitative ecologist studying how climate change and land use reshape plant–pollinator communities. My work connects field ecology, network analysis and science communication.</p>

    <p class="eyebrow">DOCTORAL RESEARCH</p>
    <div>
      <h2 id="doctoral-work">Plant–pollinator networks in a changing world</h2>
      <p class="cv-feature-place">Estación Biológica de Doñana – CSIC · University of Seville · 2022–2026</p>
      <p>My thesis brings together an eight-year time series, a 30-site landscape gradient and a European probabilistic metaweb to understand how ecological interactions respond to climate and habitat change. The thesis has been submitted, with the defence expected in January 2027.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
